name: harness
description: Audit, refactor, and document your AI coding harness: context docs, harness config, built-in skills, installed plugins.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the harness skills.

The authoritative mapping lives in this repo at `references/kimi-tools.md` — read it when a skill names a tool you do not recognise. It is the single source of truth for every repo in the `dEitY719/*-skills` family; do not copy it elsewhere. Summary:

- "Ask the user" -> `AskUserQuestion`. Every destructive step (`harness:harness-refactor` execution, `harness:ai-context refactor`, `--force` overwrite) must confirm through it first.
- `TodoWrite` -> Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- "Dispatch a subagent" -> `Agent` with `subagent_type: "coder"` (implementation) or `"explore"` (read-only). Never pass `general-purpose`.
- Read / Write / Edit / Bash / Grep / Glob keep their exposed Kimi names. Search contents with `Grep`; match paths with `Glob`.
- Kimi Code has no `Workflow` tool. `harness:harness-legacy-check` and `harness:harness-refactor` must run their steps inline or fan them out with `Agent` instead of calling a workflow runtime.
- `harness:harness-legacy-check` is read-only: never call `Write`, `Edit`, or a mutating `Bash` command from it.
